specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet for Mochi Mayhem, cute pastel confectionery fantasy, 3/4 top-down, hand-painted warm candy shading, soft but thick DARK PLUM outlines, clean bold silhouette readable at only 30 pixels. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no baked checkerboard or matte, no ground shadow, no floor, no scenery, no border, NO text/letters/numbers/watermark. Each sprite fully isolated with ample transparent margin. Same individual character identity, proportions, face, outline, colors and camera across EVERY frame; small deliberate pose changes, never redesign between frames. Face RIGHT, show three-quarter face. Exactly eight frames in a strict FOUR columns by TWO rows grid. Top row four WALK frames; bottom row four ATTACK frames. Equal cells. Feet on the same baseline in every frame. Character centered horizontally and about 70 percent cell height. No neighboring-cell fragments. Attack frame1 and4 close to walk frame1 for smooth state transitions. Tiny simple apprentice/minion, NOT the main adult companion, no elaborate costume. Character: one tiny round creamy yellow yuzu seedling, oversized cute head/body, two simple green sprout leaves growing from head, large dark eyes, small mitten arms and stubby feet. Mischievous baby fruit, no weapons. WALK top row: neutral right-facing step / small downstep / opposite step / gentle settle. ATTACK bottom row: small crouch / lean forward opening tiny mouth to bite / little chomping snap / neutral settle. Not grotesque teeth. Keep silhouette height nearly unchanged.
